blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. Census chainShares are absent; measured supplies total 7,945,689.85 MXNe: Solana 98.7154% (7,843,617.462493547 at finalized slot 458730413), Base 1.2846% (102,072.383683 at block 52800645), Stellar 0 (asset record exists with auth_revocable and auth_clawback_enabled true, but no trustlines or issued amount). Solana is the material deployment. Its SPL mint 6zYgzrT7X2wi9a9NeMtUvUWLLmf2a8vBsbYkocYdB9wa returned mintAuthority and freezeAuthority both 3mdd4X7wJjWmhF99jfTNGmSr39EXSAXcdEiS47GejduH at that slot; the authority account is System-Program-owned, non-executable and zero-data in the reviewed mint-authority census. The assigned freeze authority can freeze any holder token account, so the material deployment carries an active holder-targeted control. Base is sub-threshold but independently exposes BraleToken ControlledAccessType.Deny: at block 52800645 isAllowed(0x...dEaD)=true with hasRole(CONTROLLED_ACCESS_ROLE,0x...dEaD)=false, and MODERATOR_ROLE holder 0xb180f98037a63a3dca66b6b4ddbf250265b65110 returned true. Stellar controls are disclosed but have no supply. Pharos reports 78,180.4 peggedMXN circulating, inconsistent with measured on-chain supply; the denominator is the measured total.

oracleRisk.summary: MXNe is minted and burned by Brale as a 1:1 MXN claim against fully reserved, segregated fiat backing, so its stabilization path has no borrower collateral, no liquidation engine and no on-chain price feed. Brale's complete documentation index contains no oracle, price-feed, lending or liquidation page; the reserve disclosure names only cash at U.S. banks, liquid money-market funds and short-duration Treasury bills. Issuance and redemption are issuer-administered at par rather than read from an external feed, and secondary-market DEX pools do not price the issuer path.

branchApplicability.rationale: No price-sensitive control exists on the MXNe mint, redemption or reserve path: holders post no collateral, no borrower market or liquidation path exists on Base, Solana or Stellar, and the issuer publishes no feed identity or privileged on-chain price setter. This documentary finding does not assert how third parties price MXNe in secondary markets.
